notes: New: a full story layer. A 10-scene cinematic intro plays on a fresh save — pick a handle and an origin, meet Patch, and jack in. Origins carry a small permanent perk.

New: a mysterious corporate "Auditor" reacts to your play over time (Trace), Rosetta.exe slowly translates the world's language as you find each biome's Network Access Key, and the Port fills in with more of Neon Haven as you go — all visible on the System menu once they start.
New: an Archive tab on the Dex screen — a running diary of what you've pieced together, in the order you actually discovered it. Nothing locked ever shows early.
New: Replay Intro in the System menu — rewatch the opening scenes anytime without it touching your actual save.

Existing saves get a one-time reset to bring them into the story (Bits, Inventory, unlocked biomes and more reset to a fresh start) — every monster already in your Network Registry is kept in full. Explained in full the next time you load, and only happens once.
Rebalanced: daily login rewards now climb every day of the streak instead of dipping midweek.
Rebalanced: Exp Capsule prices roughly 4x — a level-1 partner could previously buy straight into several free levels before ever really exploring.
